items.title: 7.6 Hawa ke columns mein stationary waves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.6 with Figs. 7.8 and 7.9 and Examples 7.4 and 7.5 (PDF 150-155).

blocks.text: Stationary waves doosre media mein bhi ban sakti hain, jaise pipe ya tube ke andar hawa ka column; vibrate karte hawa ke column ki aam misal organ pipe hai.

blocks.title: Organ pipe
blocks.text: Organ pipe hawa se bajne wala saaz hai jis mein hawa ke column mein stationary waves bana kar awaz paida ki jati hai. Yeh ek khokhli lambi tube hai jis ke dono sire khule hon, ya ek sira khula aur doosra band. Aane wali aur lautne wali wave ka taalluq is par munhasir hai ke pipe ka lautane wala sira khula hai ya band: agar lautane wala sira khula ho to hawa ke molecules ko harkat ki poori azaadi hai aur woh antinode ki tarah kaam karta hai; agar band ho to node ki tarah, kyunke molecules ki harkat mehdood hai.
Soorat 1: dono siron se khule organ pipe mein vibration ke modes

Lambai l ka dono siron se khula organ pipe lein. Chunke khule sire par hawa ke molecule ko harkat ki poori azaadi hai, wahan antinode banta hai (Fig. 7.8); pipe ke andar bani longitudinal waves ko transverse kham-dar lakeeron se dikhaya gaya hai jo pipe ke mehwar (axis) ke saath mukhtalif nuqton par hawa ke zarron ka displacement aur vibration ka amplitude dikhati hain.

blocks.alt: Dono siron se khule teen pipes, rang bhare displacement ke ghere ke sath. (a) beech mein ek node, l = lambda1/2, f1 = v/2l; (b) do nodes, l = 2(lambda2/2), f2 = 2(v/2l); (c) teen nodes, l = 3(lambda3/2), f3 = 3(v/2l). (a) aur (b) ke oopar hare do-teer antinodes aur nuqte nodes dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.8: Dono siron se khule pipe mein stationary longitudinal waves (kitab ki Figure 7.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khule sire par hawa azaad hai, is liye wahan antinode (hara do-teer: hawa aage peeche) hai. Lehar daar shakal hawa ki longitudinal harkat ka andaza hai, asal mein hawa pipe ke rukh hilti hai. Har agle mode mein ek node barhta hai: f1, 2f1, 3f1, yani saare harmonics.

items: Fundamental mode (Fig. 7.8a): pipe ke beech mein sirf ek node N, aur dono khule siron par antinodes. Agar sound ki wavelength lambda1 ho to l = lambda1/4 + lambda1/4 = lambda1/2, ya lambda1 = 2l ... (7.7). Agar frequency f1 ho to v = f1 lambda1, to f1 = v/lambda1 = v/2l ... (7.8); yeh fundamental frequency ya first harmonic hai.

Doosra mode (Fig. 7.8b): teen antinodes aur do nodes. Agar wavelength lambda2 ho to l = lambda2/4 + lambda2/2 + lambda2/4 = (1 + 2 + 1) lambda2/4, ya lambda2 = l. Phir v = f2 lambda2, f2 = v/lambda2 = v/l, ya f2 = 2 f1 (kyunke v/2l = f1).

nth mode: n loops mein vibrate karte hawa ke column ke liye fn = n (v/2l), fn = n f1, aur lambda_n = 2l/n ... (7.9), jahan n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ... Yun longitudinal stationary waves ki frequencies ka alag alag set f1, 2f1, 3f1, ..., nf1 hai, harmonic series; f1 fundamental frequency hai aur baqi harmonics kehlati hain.

blocks.text: Soorat 2: ek sire se band organ pipe mein vibration ke modes
Lambai l ka ek sire se band organ pipe lein. Band sire par node aur khule sire par antinode milta hai (Fig. 7.9).

blocks.alt: Teen pipes, baen se khule aur daen se band, rang bhare ghere ke sath. (a) l = lambda1/4, f1 = v/4l; (b) l = 3(lambda3/4), f3 = 3(v/4l); (c) l = 5(lambda5/4), f5 = 5(v/4l). Har ek ke oopar hare do-teer antinodes (pehla khule sire par) aur nuqte nodes (aakhri band sire par).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.9: Ek sire se band pipe mein stationary longitudinal waves; sirf taaq (odd) harmonics (kitab ki Figure 7.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Band sire par hawa hil nahi sakti, is liye wahan hamesha node hai, aur khule sire par antinode. Is liye pipe ki lambai chauthai wavelength ke taaq (odd) mazrab hi ho sakti hai: f1, 3f1, 5f1. (a) mein beech ka chhota do-teer batata hai ke wahan hawa hilti hai magar kam; poori harkat sirf khule sire par hai.

items: Fundamental mode (Fig. 7.9a): ek node aur ek antinode. Agar fundamental mode ki wavelength lambda1 ho to pipe ki lambai l = lambda1/4, ya lambda1 = 4l ... (7.10). Speed v = f1 lambda1, to f1 = v/lambda1 = v/4l; f1 fundamental frequency hai.

Vibration ka doosra mode (Fig. 7.9b): do nodes aur do antinodes. Agar wavelength lambda3 ho to l = lambda3/4 + lambda3/2 = (3/4) lambda3, to lambda3 = 4l/3 ... (7.11). Ise v = f3 lambda3 mein rakhne par f3 = v/(4l/3) = 3v/4l, to f3 = 3 f1 (kyunke v/4l = f1). Ise third harmonic kehte hain.
nth mode: agar hawa ka column n loops mein vibrate kare to fn = n (v/4l), fn = n f1, aur lambda_n = 4l/n ... (7.12), jahan n = 1, 3, 5, ... Sirf taaq (odd) harmonics maujood hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab f3 = 3 f1 ko 'second harmonic' kehti hai. Magar harmonic ka number frequency ko f1 se taqseem kar ke milta hai: f1 pehla (first), 2f1 doosra (second) aur 3f1 teesra (third) harmonic hai, jaisa kitab khud khule pipe aur taar ke liye batati hai. Ek sire se band pipe mein 2f1 maujood hi nahi, is liye 3f1 third harmonic hai; haan, yeh vibration ka doosra mode zaroor hai.

Dono sooraton ke mutale se hum nateeja nikalte hain ke dono siron se khula pipe ek sire se band pipe ke muqable harmonics mein zyada maaldar hai: khule pipes tamam harmonics paida karte hain, jabke band pipes sirf taaq harmonics (Ponder Upon). Organ pipe mein asal chalane wala nizam flue-slit se nikalti hawa ki larazti, chadar jaisi dhaar (jet) hai jo oopar wale hont aur pipe ke hawa ke column se mil kar mustaqil oscillation qaim rakhti hai (A Scientific Fact).

blocks.title: Example 7.4
blocks.text: Ek organ pipe ki lambai 50 cm hai. Us ke fundamental note aur agle harmonic ki frequency nikalein jab woh (a) dono siron se khula, (b) ek sire se band ho (awaz ki speed = 350 m s^-1). Hal: l = 50 cm = 0.5 m, v = 350 m s^-1. (a) Khula pipe: fn = n (v/2l), n = 1, 2, 3, ...; fundamental (n = 1) f1 = 1 x 350/(2 x 0.5) = 350 Hz; agla harmonic (n = 2) f2 = 2v/2l = v/l = 350/0.5 = 700 Hz. (b) Ek sire se band: fn = n (v/4l), n = 1, 3, 5, 7, ...; fundamental f1 = 1 x 350/(4 x 0.5) = 175 Hz; agla harmonic (n = 3) f3 = 3v/4l = 3 x 350/(4 x 0.5) = 525 Hz.

blocks.title: Example 7.5
blocks.text: Church ka organ mukhtalif lambai ke pipes par mushtamil hai, har ek ek sire se khula. Sab se chhoti lambai 30 mm aur sab se lambi 4 m hai. Fundamental notes ki frequency range nikalein (awaz ki speed = 340 m s^-1). Hal: l_min = 30 mm = 30 x 10^-3 m, l_max = 4 m, v = 340 m s^-1. Sirf ek sire se khule pipe ke liye fn = nv/4l. (i) Kam se kam lambai, n = 1: f1,max = 1 x 340/(4 x 30 x 10^-3) = 2833.33 Hz. (ii) Zyada se zyada lambai, n = 1: f1,min = 1 x 340/(4 x 4) = 21.25 Hz. To fundamental frequency ki range taqreeban 21 Hz se 2833 Hz tak hai.

blocks.caption: Khule aur band pipes
rows: band sire par node, khule par antinode

blocks.prompt: Ek organ pipe 1 m lamba hai; dono siron se khula aur ek sire se band hone par fundamental aur pehle do harmonics nikalein, v = 340 m s^-1 (numerical 7.9). Flute bajane wala dekhta hai ke flute thora tez (sharp) baj rahi hai; is ki kya wajah ho sakti hai (Brain Teaser)?
blocks.explanation: Khula: f1 = v/2l = 170 Hz, phir 340 Hz aur 510 Hz. Band: f1 = v/4l = 85 Hz, phir taaq harmonics 255 Hz aur 425 Hz. Garam hawa ka column awaz ki speed barhata hai, aur chunke har frequency v ke tanasub mein hai poori flute sharp bajti hai; head joint andar dhakelna (column chhota karna) bhi yehi asar deta hai.

items: Organ pipe: khula sira antinode, band sira node. Dono taraf khula: lambda1 = 2l, f1 = v/2l, fn = n f1, lambda_n = 2l/n (tamam harmonics).

Ek taraf band: lambda1 = 4l, f1 = v/4l; lambda3 = 4l/3, f3 = 3 f1; lambda_n = 4l/n, n taaq (sirf taaq harmonics). Khule pipes harmonics mein zyada maaldar. Misalein: 350/700 Hz aur 175/525 Hz; 21 Hz se 2833 Hz.
